notes.title: Time for an update!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

If you've been following our activities over the past few years, you could've noticed we've been busy updating all our games on steam with fixes and new stuff.

Well, the time has come for "The Man with the Ivory Cane", which is a special milestone for us, since with this game, we have now updated 100% of our games, setting a new standard of quality you can expect from us.

IMPROVEMENTS:


 This update brings several fixes we've found or users have reported. Luckily none of which have been major issues.
 Now supporting MacOS and Linux natively!
 3 New translations available: German, French and Dutch
 The game can be played on Steam Deck natively (with touchscreen or mouse only for now)
 Support for Steam achievements added!
 Steam's cloud save sync now supported, across all operating systems and devices.


NOTES:

 Because of cloud sync implementation, the location where save file are stored has been changed. If you're currently playing the game, this update will reset your progress. The progress is not really lost, you just need to transfer them manually, follow the instructions in the discussion forum.
 We regularily work on all our games, so if you find any problems, even if it's just a typo in the text, please write tu us at support@cateia.com or in the game's discussion forum, we'll make sure to fix it and update the game.


Have fun! :)
